lines.2: 「I'll show that spineless idiot a thing or two.」
lines.3: 「Behold the bounty I gathered from the mountains and marvel!」
lines.4: 「Whoa, Konoe, you're amazing! Forget the Princess--Konoe's the one!」
lines.7: 「I haven't heard your apology for earlier!」
lines.9: 「If you're going that far, I suppose I can share some with you.」
lines.10: 「Yes, that's how it should go... He made fun of me, so I have to get him back.」
lines.11: 「But when it comes to finding actual food...」
lines.13: 「I don't know! I don't know anything about survival!」
lines.14: 「...I see mushrooms around, but I can't tell them apart.」
lines.15: 「Maybe I could make Tsushima eat one first.」
lines.16: 「...No. I couldn't do something that awful.」
